name: Overgrown Arcade in a Silent Mall
description: An abandoned retro arcade becomes quiet and melancholic, with plants growing through old consoles and glowing screens.
prompt: An abandoned retro arcade inside a silent shopping mall, rain crossing broken windows, vines growing through consoles, joysticks, glowing CRT screens with abstract static, moss on floor, teal and rust palette, melancholy cinematic light, ultra detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: The machines are quiet now, but the memories still flicker. What arcade game holds your first victory?
